chapter: 1977: Kansas City honor and the piano
title: Great accompanists: Bobby Henderson and Tommy Flanagan
summary: Basie says no one played for vocalists better than Henderson and praises Ella's pianist Tommy Flanagan.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: You know what I can't understand or what I would like to understand is, how come those guys that played a lot of piano, and Bobby played a lot of piano, wouldn't you say?
Yes, and I don't think anybody could play for any vocalists any greater than he could.
Never, never. I have some tapes of him, quite a few, from the sixties. Why do you say that?
I don't know. Don't ask me why because I can't tell you why.

Because there are a lot of guys that play for vocalists who are just marvelous -- say, for instance, right now, play with Ella. She's got a conductor, a pianist who I think is one of the most under-rated pianist there is. What's his name?
Really, as the guys would say, he's really out of sight.
